problem: PRODUCT_PLAN V08/V09/V10 still encode multi-Writer, FIM and RepoGraph implementation names as V1 exit requirements even though accepted architecture and subsequent production evidence do not admit those implementations. Continuing by checklist would restore rejected or deleted paths without a current attributable task loss.

required_for_implementation: a current production failure sample after the latest owning decision
a canonical production caller whose loss is attributable to the missing capability
a deterministic verifier for the affected task
a same-revision immutable-binary control and material treatment
complete request, usage, retry, wall-time and cost accounting
a minimal vertical owner and an explicit cutover deletion
selection_gate.decision_rule: Implement at most one blocker only when every required fact exists. Otherwise make an explicit product-scope decision without adding production code or consuming credentials.

V08.accepted_architecture: AgentRuntime x N plus Orchestrator; every writing agent must use an isolated worktree. ADR-0003 does not require more than one concurrent Writer.
current_production: one explicit isolated Writer per root
same AgentRuntime as root and read-only children
Host-owned worktree, diff, verifier, fast-forward integration, latest-root verification and exact cleanup
second Writer in the same or a later turn is typed rejected before allocation
V08.scope_decision_candidate: keep explicit single Writer lifecycle; reject multi-Writer as a V1 exit requirement; hold evidence-gated re-entry

current_production: official DeepSeek OpenAI ChatCompletions sender and parser
whole-catalog Strict compatibility planning with atomic lossless Standard fallback
canonical usage, retry, accounting and RunStore replay

V09.scope_decision_candidate: keep Standard/Strict routing and lossless fallback; reject FIM as a V1 exit requirement; hold full Host-owned FIM re-entry behind new attributable edit failures

V10.literal_requirement: RepoGraph implementation handles cross-file code understanding

current_production: evidence-aware ContextBroker projection and hard-limit compaction
canonical file_search, grep_files, list_dir, read_file, git_diff and git_status tools

formal_evidence.m5_c_decision: evidence-triggered; do not develop RepoGraph until a production retrieval failure is localized

V10.scope_decision_candidate: keep verified cross-file outcome and canonical retrieval owners; reject RepoGraph as a named V1 exit implementation; hold structural index re-entry behind measured retrieval loss

scope_successor_acceptance: an accepted ADR records why the three implementation literals are not V1 requirements and preserves their user-visible capability outcomes
PRODUCT_PLAN changes only after the ADR exists and keeps exactly sixteen V1 completion items
V08 requires the existing explicit single Writer lifecycle and does not admit multi-Writer
V09 requires current Standard/Strict Chat routing and lossless fallback and does not claim FIM quality
V10 requires canonical bounded cross-file retrieval plus deterministic verification and does not claim a RepoGraph exists
ROADMAP, EVALUATION, CURRENT_CODEWHALE and architecture references use one consistent 13 pass / 3 blocked successor matrix
no production model, Runtime, Store, protocol, tool catalog or routing code changes
no credential read or official API request
focused, targeted contract, fmt, workspace clippy/test and git diff --check pass

remaining_blockers: V15 billing-provable Simplified Chinese prompt comparison

non_conclusions: Multi-Writer, FIM and RepoGraph are not implemented or proven beneficial by this slice.
The existing explicit single Writer has not proven net product benefit and remains explicit-only.
FIM is not judged worse than patch/edit; it lacks a current attributable failure and a complete production treatment.
Canonical search/read tools are not claimed to dominate every future structural index.
The frozen M6, M5, M7, M8-E, M8-H and M8-J evidence is not rewritten.
No verified-success, token, wall-time or API-cost improvement is claimed.
V1 remains unreleasable while V13, V15 and V16 are blocked.
